verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official `vastai` CLI. The docs cover the whole platform from the shell: auth, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints and scoped API keys, with concrete command examples. A first-party GitHub repo (vast-ai/vast-cli) provides the CLI and SDK, and an official agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive the CLI, matching the AI-native framing. A probe independently confirmed the CLI docs page exists.
